ostrzezenia.tekst: Eggplant and summer squash, such as zucchini and pattypan squash, are low-acid foods with a pH above 4.6.
The FDA list gives ginger a pH of about 5.60–5.90.
Almost any food that is not very acidic, with a pH above 4.6, can support the growth of Clostridium botulinum and toxin production.
